title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-18
lineage: CD -> EAC(secure, offset corrected) -> TLH(flac encoding) -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Rare acoustic Truckin with Pigpen’s audible organ shines on this mostly decent soundboard capture despite some vocal low‑mix issues.
ai_review.review: The set is prized for the ultra‑rare acoustic version of “Truckin” featuring a surprisingly forward Pigpen organ, plus strong renditions of “Operator,” “St. Stephen,” and an especially lively “Not Fade Away.”  The soundboard source is clearer than most audience tapes from this era, though vocals sit low and occasional mix quirks keep the recording from being pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical performance and rarity of tracks (high show quality), but several note vocal low‑mix and overall recording imperfections, pulling the rating down to a solid but not outstanding level.

recording_quality.technical_notes: More audible than typical audience tapes; organ and drums sit well in the mix, but vocals are low and some listeners describe the overall sound as "insane" or needing aborting.

standout_songs: Going Down the Road Feelin' Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set is highlighted as impressive and cohesive, leading into an electric set that many describe as “fire” despite occasional mix issues.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ is unusually forward in the mix, a rarity for 1970/71 recordings.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann keeps a solid beat throughout, noted positively by reviewers.
